label: FP
reason: Although user input flows to the sink, it is subjected to encryption (Cipher.doFinal) and HTML encoding (ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML) immediately prior to reflection, which effectively mitigates XSS risk. The SAST tool incorrectly flags this as a vulnerability.

evidence.note: Switch statement assigns user input to bar (case 'C'), confirming data flow.
Sink uses encodeForHTML on the encrypted string, neutralizing XSS potential.
